body.statement: The law \(P^\star\) lies in the joint chart, has positive mass on all \(36\) observed cells, and has rank-two arm operators with \(\mathcal N_a(P^\star)=\mathcal K_a(P^\star)=\operatorname{span}\{(3,-7,3)^\top\}\). For the displayed constraint map \(\Xi\), the Jacobian has constant full row rank on a relatively open positive neighborhood of \(P^\star\); only on this finite chart the joint solvability locus is thereby proved to be a submanifold, with \(\mathcal T_P=\mathcal C_P^\perp\). At \(P^\star\), \(\theta(P^\star)=1/5\), \(V_{\mathrm{eff}}(P^\star)=773723312/334026875\), and the exact coefficient obstruction \(410302072/87437547015>0\) in each arm implies that no single bridge pair attains the bound. The strict nonattainment persists on a smaller relatively open chart.
body.justification: The exact chart supplies a fully path-based local witness that affine enlargement is substantive rather than a formal projection choice.
body.gap: BennettEtAl2026StronglyIdentified allows pair-dependent scores but gives no positive regular chart on which every individual pair is inefficient relative to the actual canonical gradient.
body.consumer: The witness is a reproducible early-kill test for tangent formulas and affine-ensemble implementations.
